S23.06.needs: a signed-in account with at least one project
S23.06.note: The extension has no screen that lists a project's chats or opens a project as its own workspace; only starting a chat in a project and filing a chat under one were found.
steps: Sign in to the side panel with an account that already has at least one project.
Click the message box and type @. The menu titled Tabs and projects opens.
Under the Projects heading, click a project name. The chat is started in that project.
Look for the header chip that reads Project · followed by the project name. Type a message to start the chat, then check it appears under that project.
Click the Recent chats button, then More actions for a chat, then Move to project. Choose a project in the menu Project for this chat.
Look for the confirmation Moved to <project name>. and check the chat is now filed under that project.
S23.06.where: Composer: type @ > Projects > project name (starts the chat in that project). Recent chats > More actions for a chat > Move to project (files an existing chat under a project).
